verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The paper imposes one inequality on the sum; the Lean imposes the same three products separately, as the three hypotheses hε1 : ε·S² ≤ 1, hε2 : S²ε² ≤ 1, hk2 : S²/k ≤ 1 of phaseError_le_four_div. Rewriting: ε ≥ 0 and k > 0 in context, so each of S²ε, S²ε², S²k⁻¹ is a nonnegative summand of S²(ε+ε²+k⁻¹) and the paper's inequality implies all three Lean hypotheses; conversely the three Lean hypotheses give S²(ε+ε²+k⁻¹) ≤ 3, so the two conditions agree up to the constant 3, which is immaterial since both are only used in the regime where they hold for all large band indices (eventually_band_conditions proves exactly the Lean triple there, matching the paper's next sentence "this holds for all sufficiently large band indices"). The purpose also matches: the conclusion phaseError S ε k ≤ 4/S is the paper's "bound the errors multiplied by v = O(S_*) by C/S_*", phaseError being 1/S + Sε² + S/k + εS.
